content.text:
The Takeout import finished successfully, but it does **not** connect your API account. Neither Google nor Fitbit has a verified API connection right now.

**Import status:** Succeeded. It processed 9 files and inserted 11 records. Three files were not in a supported format, and one symbolic link was skipped.

**Coverage:** Very thin. The records cover only 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-03.
- **Fitbit Takeout:**
  - Steps: 2 records on 2026-10-01.
  - Body: BMI and weight, 1 reading on 2026-10-01. The weight unit is unknown, so it is excluded from unit-converted summaries.
  - Heart rate: 1 sample and 1 resting heart rate value on 2026-10-01. The export had one day with no resting heart rate estimate, which was treated as missing.
  - Sleep: 1 session on 2026-10-02 with minutes asleep, minutes awake, time in bed and efficiency.
- **Google Takeout:** 1 step record on 2026-10-03.

Every other category has no local data.

**Not imported:**
- A sleep log CSV (columns: sleep_log_entry_id, timestamp, overall_score).
- An HTML file.
- A JSON file with an unrecognized structure (top-level key "unknownThing").
- The skipped symbolic link.

The unparsed files are kept on disk in the import folder, so they can be reviewed later.

**API connection:** Not connected. Takeout works without API access, but to connect your account you would need to run a separate connection step. Note that the legacy Fitbit Web API is scheduled to shut down on 2026-10-30, so the Fitbit route may no longer work. If you want to connect, tell me which provider you want to use and I can start that process.
